name: Microgrid restoration source-addition request
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Requests an additional compatible resource to join the established restoration island.
description: Requests an additional compatible resource to join the established restoration island. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Source readiness and island reference” at the input and “Additional source connection request” at the output. Synchronising and protection remain separately required.
